Firecrawl is a Y Combinator (S22) developer company that provides a web data API for AI. Its founders are Caleb Peffer, Eric Ciarla, and Nicolas Silberstein Camara.

**What it does:** The company's API lets developers search, scrape, crawl, and parse websites, and returns the results as clean Markdown or structured data for AI agents and LLM apps. One source describes it as converting URLs into LLM-ready markdown or structured data with a single API call. It is also open source. One listing notes it has a GitHub presence and is open source, and another says it has passed 19k GitHub stars in just 6 months.

**Founders:**
- **Caleb Peffer**, co-founder and CEO. He previously co-founded Mendable.ai, and previously established Churnkey, a software company ultimately acquired by Paddle.
- **Eric Ciarla**, co-founder.
- **Nicolas Silberstein Camara**, co-founder and CTO.

**Origins:** Firecrawl grew out of Mendable, a "chat with your data" product. Sources say Firecrawl pivoted in early 2024 to focus on web scraping APIs for large language models.

**Funding and scale (sources disagree):** Most sources list a Series A of 14.5M USD on 19 Aug 2025. One source (Dealroom) claims a later $75 million Series B led by Smash Capital in September 2026, which the other sources do not mention. Treat that figure as unverified. Employee counts also vary, from roughly 30 to about 120 depending on the source.

content.text:
**What Firecrawl does:** Firecrawl is a Y Combinator (S22) developer company. It sells a web data API for AI. Developers use it to search, scrape, crawl, and parse websites. It returns clean Markdown or structured data that LLM apps and AI agents can use. The core product is open source and has a large GitHub following.

**Founders:**
- **Caleb Peffer**, co-founder and CEO. He previously co-founded Mendable.ai and Churnkey. Paddle acquired Churnkey.
- **Eric Ciarla**, co-founder.
- **Nicolas Silberstein Camara**, co-founder and CTO.

**Origins:** Firecrawl came out of Mendable, a "chat with your data" product. Around early 2024 the team pivoted to web scraping APIs for LLMs.

**Funding:** Most sources list a $14.5M Series A in August 2025. One source, Dealroom, claims a $75M Series B in September 2026. The other sources don't mention it, so treat it as unverified.

Sources:
- [Firecrawl at Work at a Startup (YC S22)](https://workatastartup.com/jobs/64707)
- [Caleb Peffer, TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/author/caleb-peffer)
- [Seedtable: Firecrawl](https://seedtable.com/companies/firecrawl)
- [Dealroom: Firecrawl](https://dealroom.co/companies/firecrawl/)
- [Caleb Peffer, Startup Intros](https://startupintros.com/people/caleb-peffer)
